sources: SEC EDGAR submissions API: https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json (CIK 0000910521 DECK, 0001116132 TPR, 0001037038 RL)
SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts API: https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK##########.json (same three CIKs)
SEC EDGAR 8-K EX-99.1 earnings press releases and other exhibits, individual accession numbers cited inline in each dossier's Sources section

FMP MCP connector: company profile-symbol/peers endpoints only (all other endpoints -- statements, quote, earningsTranscript, analyst, insiderTrades, secFilings, news, calendar -- returned ACCESS DENIED or rate-limit errors on the current plan tier)
v4/outputs/lead_prelim_rank.csv and v4/data/d4_live_snapshot.parquet (internal, this program) for quant context (Q/V/M factor scores, NTM valuation, analyst targets, price history)

WebSearch for red-flag screening (litigation, restatements, insider selling context, CEO succession history, Capri merger termination facts) -- all such items are explicitly labelled Tier-4/secondary inline in the dossiers, never used as the sole source for a headline financial figure

coverage.intake_gate_results: all three PASS or PASS-WITH-WARNINGS via scripts/verify_data.py, 0 errors
coverage.lint_results: all three PASS-WITH-WARNINGS via scripts/lint_report.py, 0 errors after fixes (reporting-basis and disclaimer sections added)

caveats: FMP connector was almost entirely gated on this account's plan tier; all quantitative statement data was sourced directly from SEC XBRL instead, which is arguably more rigorous (primary source) but took materially more tool calls than the brief anticipated.

SEC EDGAR returned intermittent 503 errors during the session (shared rate limit across concurrently-running agents per CONVENTIONS.md); two TPR filings (Aug-2023 Capri merger 8-K, Aug-2025 Q4-FY25 earnings 8-K) could not be retrieved after repeated retries and are covered via secondary sources instead, flagged inline in the TPR dossier and in f4_summary.json's data_conflicts/key_adverse_facts.

A genuine data-quality bug was found in lead_prelim_rank.csv: TPR's 'rev' field does not equal its own 'cogs'+'gp' fields in the same row (the latter two are correct/current; 'rev' is not). Does not appear to affect Q/V/M scoring since the pre-registered model does not use raw revenue as a factor input. Flagged for the D3/D4 pipeline owners to fix at the source.
